note: Mostly internal: the third round of fixes from the 22 September engineering audit. On 1,069 design files, everything but the motor matching was checked against each file's statics and flights under all three models and the files saved from it, and moved nothing there beyond what is described here; the motor matching was checked against how each of those files opens and flies. Two changes move flight numbers. One is in the physics: a stage's nozzle exit now takes drag off its aft-most base only, where it came off every base - each pod, and any step where a wider part meets a narrower one - so a design with pods or a step flies slightly lower once its stage has a nozzle exit diameter, under Rogers Kbf, Auto and Supersonic, never under Classic Extended Barrowman. With each stage given its motors' published exit wherever the app has one, 423 of the 1,069 files fly with an exit, and 97 of them moved, all lower, most by under 0.1 percent; the largest, demon 150.rkt on an M2500T, is 1.77 percent lower under Kbf. No file in the collection that flies on open carries an exit on such a stage, but the Motors & Launch page, as in v0.138, fills an empty exit field by itself when the app has a published exit for every motor on the stage - it has one for most AeroTech and Loki motors, and for an .rse of yours that states one - including on a file opened while that page is showing, and the exit follows the motor when you change it; a file opened on another page flies as in v0.138 on this count until that page is shown. Batch simulate flies each candidate motor on its published exit where the app has one and on none where it does not, and on the stage's own figure, when it has one, for the motor already loaded, so its rows for these designs move with nothing typed. The other change is the motor matching on import: a motor named in an imported file now loads far more often - 97.8 percent of the motor references in the 973 files of the collection that open now load a motor, up from 74.0 percent, and 335 that loaded before now load a different motor - so 102 of those files open with different motors: 43 that did not leave the pad now fly, the six G115-WT files v0.138 flagged load Cesaroni's G115 instead of AeroTech's G11, one tester file (two copies in the collection) whose J100 loaded Loki's J1000 now opens with the mount empty, a motor the file did not confirm is named in the open note, and a design opened in an earlier version keeps its old motor until you open the original file again. All stats no longer opens itself in a window narrower than 981 px, a v0.136 regression. A motor whose curve is more than 5 percent off its certified impulse is now shown as that, not as a curve the app repaired. Dragging a part in the 2D view changes the design once, when you let go - the CG, CP and stats follow then - and a typed Drag analysis altitude takes effect when you leave the box. The deploy's Cloudflare token no longer shares a job with third-party build code.
